name: unifi-network
description: Full control of a Ubiquiti UniFi console (UniFi OS) from Claude Code. Bundles an MCP server that authenticates to the UniFi Network API and exposes both a generic passthrough reaching every endpoint across the classic v1, modern v2, and UniFi OS host API surfaces, plus curated tools for health, devices, clients, networks, WLANs, firewall, port-forwarding, traffic rules, events and statistics — along with a control skill and slash-command workflows. Tested against a UniFi Dream Router 7.
